rows.target: Among them were antisocial acts committed by people with extraordinary powers: Native Alters.

rows.decisions: Source nominal example list; restored English narrative predicate without changing agency.

rows.target: Another was the intrusion of the mysterious life-forms known as Orphans into human society.
rows.context: Complete prologue major-caption sequence reviewed in chronological order; full-duration OCR supports candidate timing discovery.
rows.decisions: My-HiME creatures; never the Ohfun kingdom.

rows.target: Another was a case of blood-draining murder by demihuman creatures known as chiropterans.
rows.context: Complete prologue major-caption sequence reviewed in chronological order; full-duration OCR supports candidate timing discovery.
rows.decisions: Preserve a blood-draining murder case and demihuman description; no invented series or inferiority claim. Root-approved meaning refinement.

rows.target: Another was the attack on the Library of Congress by resurrected I-Jin.
rows.context: Complete prologue major-caption sequence reviewed in chronological order; full-duration OCR supports candidate timing discovery.
rows.decisions: Source past attack, not a planned future incident.

rows.target: Yet there were those who stood against these threats.

rows.decisions: Narrative full predicate.

rows.target: To preserve peace and order in society, or for reasons of their own, they confronted these threats.

rows.decisions: Emerging confirmation, not already universally known fact; source named category protected.

rows.target: They all murmured the same question: "Where is Hell's Gate!?"

rows.decisions: Contractors are settled plural subject, quote remains a location question.

rows.context: Complete prologue major-caption sequence reviewed in chronological order; full-duration OCR supports candidate timing discovery.
rows.decisions: Building signage, same company as following caption. Source signage is separate visible occurrence. Intentional nominal heading, issuer label or list within this source block is retained.

rows.target:

An investigative company entrusted with assignments by intelligence agencies around the world.
"No one in intelligence is unfamiliar with the name S.I.R."
Its capabilities inspire such whispers, yet this private company remains virtually unknown to the general public.

rows.decisions: Company introduction; agencies commission substitute work, not company hiring the agencies. Quote retains widespread intelligence recognition versus public obscurity. Intentional nominal heading, issuer label or list within this source block is retained.

rows.target: This group of agents received a request for an investigation.

rows.decisions: Incoming request direction preserved.

rows.target:

Question Captain Martin Zigmarl about the circumstances.
If this does not yield the necessary information, the choice of further methods is left to your discretion.

rows.decisions: Formal written assignment; explicit ordered questioning, conditional discretion, and expectations retained. No restriction/permission beyond source. Intentional nominal heading, issuer label or list within this source block is retained.

rows.target: It was an exceedingly strange request for an investigation.

rows.decisions: Narration full predicate.

rows.target: This is where the story begins.

rows.decisions: Closing narration first appears after previous caption; do not count repeated prior caption as new unique prose.

rows.target: Mitch and I jumped into the dimensional rift, but we lost consciousness in an instant. When I came to, I was in a hospital bed.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: The settled compound topic is Mitch and the protagonist: both lose consciousness. The following first-person awakening does not imply Mitch awoke at the same instant.

rows.target: It was a hospital in Brazil, a place I had no connection to.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Restore the descriptive predicate; Brazil is the country, not the distinct fictional Brazilial.

rows.target: I was told we'd washed ashore, where local police found us, and that we'd been lucky enough to be rescued.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Reported rescue; source places good fortune on the rescue.

rows.target: A month later, I returned to Japan, but the pursuit I'd been bracing for from the organization never came,
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Sentence deliberately continues into the following caption. No organization identity or interrogation method added.

rows.target: and another three weeks later, I was to return to work at S.I.R.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Continuation of previous caption; restore the settled first-person subject.

rows.target: Mitch and I jumped into the dimensional rift, but we lost consciousness in an instant. When I came to, I was in a hospital bed.

rows.target: It was a hospital in Brazil, a place I had no connection to.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: The adjacent awakening settles the omitted experiencer; restore predicate.

rows.target: I was told we'd washed ashore and were rescued after local police fortunately found us.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Female version places good fortune on discovery by police, unlike the male rescue wording.

rows.target: A month later, I returned to Japan, but the pursuit I'd been bracing for from the organization never came,

rows.decisions: Identical full caption; intentional cross-caption connective remains unfinished.

rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Female version explicitly states the first-person subject.

rows.target: The monster Rain revealed a horrifying form, and a dimensional storm swept everything up. Amid it all, I lost consciousness.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Rain is the named monster; no new gender or transformation mechanism added.

rows.target: The next time I regained consciousness, I was in a prison, not a hospital bed.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Restore first-person subject and explicit prison versus hospital contrast.

rows.target: Yes, I have no freedom now.
rows.context: Baked world card or chronological protagonist recap; complete adjacent caption states read in both route movies.
rows.decisions: Written initial affirmative retained; not a dialogue answer invented outside the recap.

rows.target: In that windowless prison, I kept watching my surroundings, waiting for a chance to escape.

rows.decisions: Prolonged vigilance and opportunity, not a completed escape.
